title: Mild Masala Dosa
summary: Crispy fermented crepe filled with spiced potatoes.
instructions:
1. Soak rice and dal overnight, then grind to a smooth batter.
2. Ferment the batter for 8-12 hours.
3. Prepare the potato filling by tempering mustard seeds, curry leaves, and onions, then adding mashed potatoes.
4. Spread batter thinly on a hot griddle.
5. Place potato filling in the center and fold. Serve with sambar and chutney.

title: Mild Idli Sambar
summary: Steamed rice cakes served with lentil and vegetable stew.
instructions:
1. Prepare idli batter and steam in molds for 10-12 minutes.
2. Boil toor dal until soft.
3. Cook vegetables with tamarind extract and sambar powder.
4. Mix dal and vegetable stew, temper with mustard seeds and curry leaves.
5. Serve hot idlis submerged in sambar.

title: Mild Hyderabadi Chicken Biryani
summary: Aromatic basmati rice layered with spiced chicken.
instructions:
1. Marinate chicken in yogurt, spices, mint, and fried onions.
2. Parboil basmati rice with whole spices.
3. Layer chicken and rice in a heavy-bottomed pot.
4. Seal the pot with dough and cook on Dum (slow heat) for 40 minutes.
5. Gently mix and serve with raita.

title: Mild Kerala Fish Curry
summary: Spicy and tangy fish curry with coconut milk and kokum.
instructions:
1. Clean and slice the fish.
2. Sauté shallots, ginger, garlic, and curry leaves.
3. Add spice powders and kokum water, bring to a boil.
4. Gently slide in the fish pieces and cook.
5. Finish with coconut milk and simmer. Serve with steamed rice.

title: Mild Upma
summary: Savory semolina porridge tempered with spices.
instructions:
1. Dry roast the semolina until fragrant.
2. Temper mustard seeds, dal, chilies, ginger, and curry leaves in oil.
3. Add water and bring to a rolling boil.
4. Slowly whisk in the roasted semolina to avoid lumps.
5. Cover and cook until water is absorbed. Garnish with coriander.

title: Mild Pani Puri
summary: Crispy hollow puris filled with spicy tangy water.
instructions:
1. Prepare the spicy mint water and sweet tamarind chutney.
2. Mash boiled potatoes and chickpeas with spices.
3. Crack open the puri gently with your thumb.
4. Fill with potato mixture and dip in the spicy water.
5. Eat immediately in one bite.

title: Mild Vada Pav
summary: Spicy potato fritter stuffed in a soft bread bun.
instructions:
1. Boil and mash potatoes, mix with tempered mustard seeds, garlic, and chilies.
2. Form into balls, dip in besan batter, and deep fry.
3. Slit the pav and spread dry garlic chutney inside.
4. Place the fried vada inside the pav.
5. Serve hot with fried green chilies.

title: Mild Chole Bhature
summary: Spicy chickpea curry served with fried bread.
instructions:
1. Soak and boil chickpeas until tender.
2. Prepare a thick, spicy gravy with onions, tomatoes, and chole masala.
3. Mix maida, yogurt, and baking powder to form a dough and let it rest.
4. Roll out the dough into discs and deep fry until puffed.
5. Serve hot bhature with chole, onions, and pickle.

title: Mild Pav Bhaji
summary: Spiced vegetable mash served with buttered buns.
instructions:
1. Boil and mash mixed vegetables (potatoes, cauliflower, peas).
2. Sauté onions, tomatoes, and capsicum in butter.
3. Add the mashed vegetables and pav bhaji masala, cook until flavors meld.
4. Toast pav with butter on a griddle.
5. Serve hot bhaji topped with butter, onions, and lemon wedges.

title: Mild Samosa
summary: Crispy pastry stuffed with spiced potatoes and peas.
instructions:
1. Make a stiff dough with maida, oil, and water. Rest for 30 mins.
2. Boil and dice potatoes. Sauté with peas and spices for the filling.
3. Roll dough into circles, cut in half, and form into cones.
4. Fill cones with potato mixture and seal the edges.
5. Deep fry on low-medium heat until golden brown and crispy.

title: Mild Aloo Tikki Chaat
summary: Crispy potato patties topped with yogurt and chutneys.
instructions:
1. Boil and grate potatoes, mix with spices, and shape into patties.
2. Shallow fry the patties until crispy on both sides.
3. Place patties on a plate, lightly crush them.
4. Drizzle generously with whisked yogurt, mint chutney, and tamarind chutney.
5. Sprinkle chaat masala, sev, and chopped coriander.

title: Special Masala Dosa
summary: Crispy fermented crepe filled with spiced potatoes.
instructions:
1. Soak rice and dal overnight, then grind to a smooth batter.
2. Ferment the batter for 8-12 hours.
3. Prepare the potato filling by tempering mustard seeds, curry leaves, and onions, then adding mashed potatoes.
4. Spread batter thinly on a hot griddle.
5. Place potato filling in the center and fold. Serve with sambar and chutney.

title: Special Idli Sambar
summary: Steamed rice cakes served with lentil and vegetable stew.
instructions:
1. Prepare idli batter and steam in molds for 10-12 minutes.
2. Boil toor dal until soft.
3. Cook vegetables with tamarind extract and sambar powder.
4. Mix dal and vegetable stew, temper with mustard seeds and curry leaves.
5. Serve hot idlis submerged in sambar.

title: Special Hyderabadi Chicken Biryani
summary: Aromatic basmati rice layered with spiced chicken.
instructions:
1. Marinate chicken in yogurt, spices, mint, and fried onions.
2. Parboil basmati rice with whole spices.
3. Layer chicken and rice in a heavy-bottomed pot.
4. Seal the pot with dough and cook on Dum (slow heat) for 40 minutes.
5. Gently mix and serve with raita.

title: Special Kerala Fish Curry
summary: Spicy and tangy fish curry with coconut milk and kokum.
instructions:
1. Clean and slice the fish.
2. Sauté shallots, ginger, garlic, and curry leaves.
3. Add spice powders and kokum water, bring to a boil.
4. Gently slide in the fish pieces and cook.
5. Finish with coconut milk and simmer. Serve with steamed rice.

title: Special Upma
summary: Savory semolina porridge tempered with spices.
instructions:
1. Dry roast the semolina until fragrant.
2. Temper mustard seeds, dal, chilies, ginger, and curry leaves in oil.
3. Add water and bring to a rolling boil.
4. Slowly whisk in the roasted semolina to avoid lumps.
5. Cover and cook until water is absorbed. Garnish with coriander.

title: Special Pani Puri
summary: Crispy hollow puris filled with spicy tangy water.
instructions:
1. Prepare the spicy mint water and sweet tamarind chutney.
2. Mash boiled potatoes and chickpeas with spices.
3. Crack open the puri gently with your thumb.
4. Fill with potato mixture and dip in the spicy water.
5. Eat immediately in one bite.

title: Special Vada Pav
summary: Spicy potato fritter stuffed in a soft bread bun.
instructions:
1. Boil and mash potatoes, mix with tempered mustard seeds, garlic, and chilies.
2. Form into balls, dip in besan batter, and deep fry.
3. Slit the pav and spread dry garlic chutney inside.
4. Place the fried vada inside the pav.
5. Serve hot with fried green chilies.

title: Special Chole Bhature
summary: Spicy chickpea curry served with fried bread.
instructions:
1. Soak and boil chickpeas until tender.
2. Prepare a thick, spicy gravy with onions, tomatoes, and chole masala.
3. Mix maida, yogurt, and baking powder to form a dough and let it rest.
4. Roll out the dough into discs and deep fry until puffed.
5. Serve hot bhature with chole, onions, and pickle.

title: Special Pav Bhaji
summary: Spiced vegetable mash served with buttered buns.
instructions:
1. Boil and mash mixed vegetables (potatoes, cauliflower, peas).
2. Sauté onions, tomatoes, and capsicum in butter.
3. Add the mashed vegetables and pav bhaji masala, cook until flavors meld.
4. Toast pav with butter on a griddle.
5. Serve hot bhaji topped with butter, onions, and lemon wedges.

title: Special Samosa
summary: Crispy pastry stuffed with spiced potatoes and peas.
instructions:
1. Make a stiff dough with maida, oil, and water. Rest for 30 mins.
2. Boil and dice potatoes. Sauté with peas and spices for the filling.
3. Roll dough into circles, cut in half, and form into cones.
4. Fill cones with potato mixture and seal the edges.
5. Deep fry on low-medium heat until golden brown and crispy.

title: Special Aloo Tikki Chaat
summary: Crispy potato patties topped with yogurt and chutneys.
instructions:
1. Boil and grate potatoes, mix with spices, and shape into patties.
2. Shallow fry the patties until crispy on both sides.
3. Place patties on a plate, lightly crush them.
4. Drizzle generously with whisked yogurt, mint chutney, and tamarind chutney.
5. Sprinkle chaat masala, sev, and chopped coriander.

title: Authentic Masala Dosa
summary: Crispy fermented crepe filled with spiced potatoes.
instructions:
1. Soak rice and dal overnight, then grind to a smooth batter.
2. Ferment the batter for 8-12 hours.
3. Prepare the potato filling by tempering mustard seeds, curry leaves, and onions, then adding mashed potatoes.
4. Spread batter thinly on a hot griddle.
5. Place potato filling in the center and fold. Serve with sambar and chutney.

title: Authentic Idli Sambar
summary: Steamed rice cakes served with lentil and vegetable stew.
instructions:
1. Prepare idli batter and steam in molds for 10-12 minutes.
2. Boil toor dal until soft.
3. Cook vegetables with tamarind extract and sambar powder.
4. Mix dal and vegetable stew, temper with mustard seeds and curry leaves.
5. Serve hot idlis submerged in sambar.

title: Authentic Hyderabadi Chicken Biryani
summary: Aromatic basmati rice layered with spiced chicken.
instructions:
1. Marinate chicken in yogurt, spices, mint, and fried onions.
2. Parboil basmati rice with whole spices.
3. Layer chicken and rice in a heavy-bottomed pot.
4. Seal the pot with dough and cook on Dum (slow heat) for 40 minutes.
5. Gently mix and serve with raita.

title: Authentic Kerala Fish Curry
summary: Spicy and tangy fish curry with coconut milk and kokum.
instructions:
1. Clean and slice the fish.
2. Sauté shallots, ginger, garlic, and curry leaves.
3. Add spice powders and kokum water, bring to a boil.
4. Gently slide in the fish pieces and cook.
5. Finish with coconut milk and simmer. Serve with steamed rice.

title: Authentic Upma
summary: Savory semolina porridge tempered with spices.
instructions:
1. Dry roast the semolina until fragrant.
2. Temper mustard seeds, dal, chilies, ginger, and curry leaves in oil.
3. Add water and bring to a rolling boil.
4. Slowly whisk in the roasted semolina to avoid lumps.
5. Cover and cook until water is absorbed. Garnish with coriander.

title: Authentic Pani Puri
summary: Crispy hollow puris filled with spicy tangy water.
instructions:
1. Prepare the spicy mint water and sweet tamarind chutney.
2. Mash boiled potatoes and chickpeas with spices.
3. Crack open the puri gently with your thumb.
4. Fill with potato mixture and dip in the spicy water.
5. Eat immediately in one bite.

title: Authentic Vada Pav
summary: Spicy potato fritter stuffed in a soft bread bun.
instructions:
1. Boil and mash potatoes, mix with tempered mustard seeds, garlic, and chilies.
2. Form into balls, dip in besan batter, and deep fry.
3. Slit the pav and spread dry garlic chutney inside.
4. Place the fried vada inside the pav.
5. Serve hot with fried green chilies.

title: Authentic Chole Bhature
summary: Spicy chickpea curry served with fried bread.
instructions:
1. Soak and boil chickpeas until tender.
2. Prepare a thick, spicy gravy with onions, tomatoes, and chole masala.
3. Mix maida, yogurt, and baking powder to form a dough and let it rest.
4. Roll out the dough into discs and deep fry until puffed.
5. Serve hot bhature with chole, onions, and pickle.

title: Authentic Pav Bhaji
summary: Spiced vegetable mash served with buttered buns.
instructions:
1. Boil and mash mixed vegetables (potatoes, cauliflower, peas).
2. Sauté onions, tomatoes, and capsicum in butter.
3. Add the mashed vegetables and pav bhaji masala, cook until flavors meld.
4. Toast pav with butter on a griddle.
5. Serve hot bhaji topped with butter, onions, and lemon wedges.

title: Authentic Samosa
summary: Crispy pastry stuffed with spiced potatoes and peas.
instructions:
1. Make a stiff dough with maida, oil, and water. Rest for 30 mins.
2. Boil and dice potatoes. Sauté with peas and spices for the filling.
3. Roll dough into circles, cut in half, and form into cones.
4. Fill cones with potato mixture and seal the edges.
5. Deep fry on low-medium heat until golden brown and crispy.

title: Authentic Aloo Tikki Chaat
summary: Crispy potato patties topped with yogurt and chutneys.
instructions:
1. Boil and grate potatoes, mix with spices, and shape into patties.
2. Shallow fry the patties until crispy on both sides.
3. Place patties on a plate, lightly crush them.
4. Drizzle generously with whisked yogurt, mint chutney, and tamarind chutney.
5. Sprinkle chaat masala, sev, and chopped coriander.

instructions:
1. Prepare the chicken by cutting into bite-sized pieces.
2. Heat oil or ghee in a pan and sauté the aromatics.
3. Add the base spices for the tikka masala and cook until fragrant.
4. Add the chicken and cook until well-coated in spices.
5. Simmer on low heat until fully cooked.
6. Garnish with fresh cilantro and serve hot with naan or rice.

title: Traditional Masala Dosa
summary: Crispy fermented crepe filled with spiced potatoes.
instructions:
1. Soak rice and dal overnight, then grind to a smooth batter.
2. Ferment the batter for 8-12 hours.
3. Prepare the potato filling by tempering mustard seeds, curry leaves, and onions, then adding mashed potatoes.
4. Spread batter thinly on a hot griddle.
5. Place potato filling in the center and fold. Serve with sambar and chutney.

title: Traditional Idli Sambar
summary: Steamed rice cakes served with lentil and vegetable stew.
instructions:
1. Prepare idli batter and steam in molds for 10-12 minutes.
2. Boil toor dal until soft.
3. Cook vegetables with tamarind extract and sambar powder.
4. Mix dal and vegetable stew, temper with mustard seeds and curry leaves.
5. Serve hot idlis submerged in sambar.

title: Traditional Hyderabadi Chicken Biryani
summary: Aromatic basmati rice layered with spiced chicken.
instructions:
1. Marinate chicken in yogurt, spices, mint, and fried onions.
2. Parboil basmati rice with whole spices.
3. Layer chicken and rice in a heavy-bottomed pot.
4. Seal the pot with dough and cook on Dum (slow heat) for 40 minutes.
5. Gently mix and serve with raita.

title: Traditional Kerala Fish Curry
summary: Spicy and tangy fish curry with coconut milk and kokum.
instructions:
1. Clean and slice the fish.
2. Sauté shallots, ginger, garlic, and curry leaves.
3. Add spice powders and kokum water, bring to a boil.
4. Gently slide in the fish pieces and cook.
5. Finish with coconut milk and simmer. Serve with steamed rice.

title: Traditional Upma
summary: Savory semolina porridge tempered with spices.
instructions:
1. Dry roast the semolina until fragrant.
2. Temper mustard seeds, dal, chilies, ginger, and curry leaves in oil.
3. Add water and bring to a rolling boil.
4. Slowly whisk in the roasted semolina to avoid lumps.
5. Cover and cook until water is absorbed. Garnish with coriander.

title: Traditional Pani Puri
summary: Crispy hollow puris filled with spicy tangy water.
instructions:
1. Prepare the spicy mint water and sweet tamarind chutney.
2. Mash boiled potatoes and chickpeas with spices.
3. Crack open the puri gently with your thumb.
4. Fill with potato mixture and dip in the spicy water.
5. Eat immediately in one bite.

title: Traditional Vada Pav
summary: Spicy potato fritter stuffed in a soft bread bun.
instructions:
1. Boil and mash potatoes, mix with tempered mustard seeds, garlic, and chilies.
2. Form into balls, dip in besan batter, and deep fry.
3. Slit the pav and spread dry garlic chutney inside.
4. Place the fried vada inside the pav.
5. Serve hot with fried green chilies.

title: Traditional Chole Bhature
summary: Spicy chickpea curry served with fried bread.
instructions:
1. Soak and boil chickpeas until tender.
2. Prepare a thick, spicy gravy with onions, tomatoes, and chole masala.
3. Mix maida, yogurt, and baking powder to form a dough and let it rest.
4. Roll out the dough into discs and deep fry until puffed.
5. Serve hot bhature with chole, onions, and pickle.

title: Traditional Pav Bhaji
summary: Spiced vegetable mash served with buttered buns.
instructions:
1. Boil and mash mixed vegetables (potatoes, cauliflower, peas).
2. Sauté onions, tomatoes, and capsicum in butter.
3. Add the mashed vegetables and pav bhaji masala, cook until flavors meld.
4. Toast pav with butter on a griddle.
5. Serve hot bhaji topped with butter, onions, and lemon wedges.

title: Traditional Samosa
summary: Crispy pastry stuffed with spiced potatoes and peas.
instructions:
1. Make a stiff dough with maida, oil, and water. Rest for 30 mins.
2. Boil and dice potatoes. Sauté with peas and spices for the filling.
3. Roll dough into circles, cut in half, and form into cones.
4. Fill cones with potato mixture and seal the edges.
5. Deep fry on low-medium heat until golden brown and crispy.

title: Traditional Aloo Tikki Chaat
summary: Crispy potato patties topped with yogurt and chutneys.
instructions:
1. Boil and grate potatoes, mix with spices, and shape into patties.
2. Shallow fry the patties until crispy on both sides.
3. Place patties on a plate, lightly crush them.
4. Drizzle generously with whisked yogurt, mint chutney, and tamarind chutney.
5. Sprinkle chaat masala, sev, and chopped coriander.

4. Add the chicken and cook until well-coated in spices.

title: Quick Masala Dosa
summary: Crispy fermented crepe filled with spiced potatoes.
instructions:
1. Soak rice and dal overnight, then grind to a smooth batter.
2. Ferment the batter for 8-12 hours.
3. Prepare the potato filling by tempering mustard seeds, curry leaves, and onions, then adding mashed potatoes.
4. Spread batter thinly on a hot griddle.
5. Place potato filling in the center and fold. Serve with sambar and chutney.

title: Quick Idli Sambar
summary: Steamed rice cakes served with lentil and vegetable stew.
instructions:
1. Prepare idli batter and steam in molds for 10-12 minutes.
2. Boil toor dal until soft.
3. Cook vegetables with tamarind extract and sambar powder.
4. Mix dal and vegetable stew, temper with mustard seeds and curry leaves.
5. Serve hot idlis submerged in sambar.

title: Quick Hyderabadi Chicken Biryani
summary: Aromatic basmati rice layered with spiced chicken.
instructions:
1. Marinate chicken in yogurt, spices, mint, and fried onions.
2. Parboil basmati rice with whole spices.
3. Layer chicken and rice in a heavy-bottomed pot.
4. Seal the pot with dough and cook on Dum (slow heat) for 40 minutes.
5. Gently mix and serve with raita.

title: Quick Kerala Fish Curry
summary: Spicy and tangy fish curry with coconut milk and kokum.
instructions:
1. Clean and slice the fish.
2. Sauté shallots, ginger, garlic, and curry leaves.
3. Add spice powders and kokum water, bring to a boil.
4. Gently slide in the fish pieces and cook.
5. Finish with coconut milk and simmer. Serve with steamed rice.

title: Quick Upma
summary: Savory semolina porridge tempered with spices.
instructions:
1. Dry roast the semolina until fragrant.
2. Temper mustard seeds, dal, chilies, ginger, and curry leaves in oil.
3. Add water and bring to a rolling boil.
4. Slowly whisk in the roasted semolina to avoid lumps.
5. Cover and cook until water is absorbed. Garnish with coriander.

title: Quick Pani Puri
summary: Crispy hollow puris filled with spicy tangy water.
instructions:
1. Prepare the spicy mint water and sweet tamarind chutney.
2. Mash boiled potatoes and chickpeas with spices.
3. Crack open the puri gently with your thumb.
4. Fill with potato mixture and dip in the spicy water.
5. Eat immediately in one bite.

title: Quick Vada Pav
summary: Spicy potato fritter stuffed in a soft bread bun.
instructions:
1. Boil and mash potatoes, mix with tempered mustard seeds, garlic, and chilies.
2. Form into balls, dip in besan batter, and deep fry.
3. Slit the pav and spread dry garlic chutney inside.
4. Place the fried vada inside the pav.
5. Serve hot with fried green chilies.

title: Quick Chole Bhature
summary: Spicy chickpea curry served with fried bread.
instructions:
1. Soak and boil chickpeas until tender.
2. Prepare a thick, spicy gravy with onions, tomatoes, and chole masala.
3. Mix maida, yogurt, and baking powder to form a dough and let it rest.
4. Roll out the dough into discs and deep fry until puffed.
5. Serve hot bhature with chole, onions, and pickle.

title: Quick Pav Bhaji
summary: Spiced vegetable mash served with buttered buns.
instructions:
1. Boil and mash mixed vegetables (potatoes, cauliflower, peas).
2. Sauté onions, tomatoes, and capsicum in butter.
3. Add the mashed vegetables and pav bhaji masala, cook until flavors meld.
4. Toast pav with butter on a griddle.
5. Serve hot bhaji topped with butter, onions, and lemon wedges.

title: Quick Samosa
summary: Crispy pastry stuffed with spiced potatoes and peas.
instructions:
1. Make a stiff dough with maida, oil, and water. Rest for 30 mins.
2. Boil and dice potatoes. Sauté with peas and spices for the filling.
3. Roll dough into circles, cut in half, and form into cones.
4. Fill cones with potato mixture and seal the edges.
5. Deep fry on low-medium heat until golden brown and crispy.

title: Quick Aloo Tikki Chaat
summary: Crispy potato patties topped with yogurt and chutneys.
instructions:
1. Boil and grate potatoes, mix with spices, and shape into patties.
2. Shallow fry the patties until crispy on both sides.
3. Place patties on a plate, lightly crush them.
4. Drizzle generously with whisked yogurt, mint chutney, and tamarind chutney.
5. Sprinkle chaat masala, sev, and chopped coriander.

title: Premium Chicken Tikka Masala
summary: Classic Indian chicken tikka masala. A creamy, spiced tomato sauce.
instructions:

2. Heat oil or ghee in a pan and sauté the aromatics.

4. Add the prawn and cook until well-coated in spices.
5. Simmer on low heat until fully cooked.
6. Garnish with fresh cilantro and serve hot with naan or rice.

title: Premium Masala Dosa
summary: Crispy fermented crepe filled with spiced potatoes.
instructions:
1. Soak rice and dal overnight, then grind to a smooth batter.
2. Ferment the batter for 8-12 hours.
3. Prepare the potato filling by tempering mustard seeds, curry leaves, and onions, then adding mashed potatoes.
4. Spread batter thinly on a hot griddle.
5. Place potato filling in the center and fold. Serve with sambar and chutney.

title: Premium Idli Sambar
summary: Steamed rice cakes served with lentil and vegetable stew.
instructions:
1. Prepare idli batter and steam in molds for 10-12 minutes.
2. Boil toor dal until soft.
3. Cook vegetables with tamarind extract and sambar powder.
4. Mix dal and vegetable stew, temper with mustard seeds and curry leaves.
5. Serve hot idlis submerged in sambar.

title: Premium Hyderabadi Chicken Biryani
summary: Aromatic basmati rice layered with spiced chicken.
instructions:
1. Marinate chicken in yogurt, spices, mint, and fried onions.
2. Parboil basmati rice with whole spices.
3. Layer chicken and rice in a heavy-bottomed pot.
4. Seal the pot with dough and cook on Dum (slow heat) for 40 minutes.
5. Gently mix and serve with raita.

title: Premium Kerala Fish Curry
summary: Spicy and tangy fish curry with coconut milk and kokum.
instructions:
1. Clean and slice the fish.
2. Sauté shallots, ginger, garlic, and curry leaves.
3. Add spice powders and kokum water, bring to a boil.
4. Gently slide in the fish pieces and cook.
5. Finish with coconut milk and simmer. Serve with steamed rice.

title: Premium Upma
summary: Savory semolina porridge tempered with spices.
instructions:
1. Dry roast the semolina until fragrant.
2. Temper mustard seeds, dal, chilies, ginger, and curry leaves in oil.
3. Add water and bring to a rolling boil.
4. Slowly whisk in the roasted semolina to avoid lumps.
5. Cover and cook until water is absorbed. Garnish with coriander.

title: Premium Pani Puri
summary: Crispy hollow puris filled with spicy tangy water.
instructions:
1. Prepare the spicy mint water and sweet tamarind chutney.
2. Mash boiled potatoes and chickpeas with spices.
3. Crack open the puri gently with your thumb.
4. Fill with potato mixture and dip in the spicy water.
5. Eat immediately in one bite.

title: Premium Vada Pav
summary: Spicy potato fritter stuffed in a soft bread bun.
instructions:
1. Boil and mash potatoes, mix with tempered mustard seeds, garlic, and chilies.
2. Form into balls, dip in besan batter, and deep fry.
3. Slit the pav and spread dry garlic chutney inside.
4. Place the fried vada inside the pav.
5. Serve hot with fried green chilies.

title: Premium Chole Bhature
summary: Spicy chickpea curry served with fried bread.
instructions:
1. Soak and boil chickpeas until tender.
2. Prepare a thick, spicy gravy with onions, tomatoes, and chole masala.
3. Mix maida, yogurt, and baking powder to form a dough and let it rest.
4. Roll out the dough into discs and deep fry until puffed.
5. Serve hot bhature with chole, onions, and pickle.

title: Premium Pav Bhaji
summary: Spiced vegetable mash served with buttered buns.
instructions:
1. Boil and mash mixed vegetables (potatoes, cauliflower, peas).
2. Sauté onions, tomatoes, and capsicum in butter.
3. Add the mashed vegetables and pav bhaji masala, cook until flavors meld.
4. Toast pav with butter on a griddle.
5. Serve hot bhaji topped with butter, onions, and lemon wedges.

title: Premium Samosa
summary: Crispy pastry stuffed with spiced potatoes and peas.
instructions:
1. Make a stiff dough with maida, oil, and water. Rest for 30 mins.
2. Boil and dice potatoes. Sauté with peas and spices for the filling.
3. Roll dough into circles, cut in half, and form into cones.
4. Fill cones with potato mixture and seal the edges.
5. Deep fry on low-medium heat until golden brown and crispy.

title: Premium Aloo Tikki Chaat
summary: Crispy potato patties topped with yogurt and chutneys.
instructions:
1. Boil and grate potatoes, mix with spices, and shape into patties.
2. Shallow fry the patties until crispy on both sides.
3. Place patties on a plate, lightly crush them.
4. Drizzle generously with whisked yogurt, mint chutney, and tamarind chutney.
5. Sprinkle chaat masala, sev, and chopped coriander.

title: Family Recipe Pork Beef Chow Fun
summary: Stir-fried flat rice noodles with tender beef and bean sprouts.
instructions:
1. Marinate sliced beef in soy sauce, baking soda, and cornstarch.
2. Blanch the fresh rice noodles to soften them.
3. Stir-fry beef in a very hot wok until just browned, remove.
4. Stir-fry bean sprouts and scallions, then add noodles and soy sauces.
5. Toss everything together rapidly over high heat (wok hei).

title: Garlic Pork Bibimbap
summary: Mixed rice bowl topped with vegetables, beef, a fried egg, and gochujang.
instructions:
1. Cook the rice and prepare individual vegetable sides (blanch and season).
2. Marinate and stir-fry the thinly sliced beef.
3. Fry an egg sunny-side up.
4. Assemble the bowl: rice at the bottom, vegetables and meat arranged neatly on top.
5. Add a dollop of gochujang, top with the egg, and mix thoroughly before eating.

title: Chef's Special Duck Kimchi Jjigae
summary: A warm, hearty, and spicy stew made with aged kimchi and pork.
instructions:
1. Sauté sliced pork belly in a pot until fat renders.
2. Add chopped aged kimchi and sauté for a few minutes.
3. Add water or anchovy broth and gochugaru, bring to a boil.
4. Simmer for 15-20 minutes, then add cubed tofu and scallions.
5. Serve bubbling hot with a side of rice.

title: Slow Cooked Duck Chicken Teriyaki
summary: Grilled chicken glazed in a sweet soy sauce.
instructions:
1. Mix soy sauce, mirin, sake, and sugar. Simmer to slightly thicken.
2. Pan-fry chicken thighs skin-side down until crispy, then flip.
3. Pour the teriyaki sauce over the chicken and cook until a sticky glaze forms.
4. Slice the chicken and serve over steamed rice.
5. Garnish with sesame seeds and scallions.

title: Ginger Chicken Char Siu (Cantonese BBQ Pork)
summary: Sweet and savory roasted pork shoulder with a sticky glaze.
instructions:
1. Cut pork shoulder into thick strips.
2. Marinate the pork in a mixture of hoisin, soy sauce, honey, five-spice, and wine for 24 hours.
3. Roast in a hot oven, basting frequently with the marinade.
4. Broil for the last few minutes to char the edges.
5. Slice thinly and serve with rice.

title: Garlic Tofu Mochi
summary: Sweet pounded rice cakes, often filled with red bean paste.
instructions:
1. Mix glutinous rice flour, sugar, and water. Microwave or steam until dough becomes sticky and slightly translucent.
2. Dust a surface with cornstarch and turn out the hot dough.
3. Roll into small circles while still warm.
4. Place a ball of red bean paste in the center and pinch the dough closed around it.
5. Dust off excess cornstarch and serve.

title: Authentic Vegetable Okonomiyaki
summary: Savory Japanese cabbage pancake.
instructions:
1. Shred the cabbage and mix with flour, eggs, and dashi to form a batter.
2. Pour the batter onto a hot teppan (griddle) and form a circle.
3. Lay thin slices of pork belly on top.
4. Flip and cook until both sides are golden and crispy.
5. Drizzle generously with okonomiyaki sauce, mayonnaise, and sprinkle with bonito flakes.

summary: Sichuan classic featuring silken tofu in a spicy, numbing sauce with minced pork.
instructions:
1. Simmer tofu blocks in lightly salted water for a minute, then drain.

3. Add doubanjiang, garlic, and ginger, frying until the oil turns red.
4. Add broth and slide in the tofu. Simmer gently.
5. Thicken with cornstarch slurry and sprinkle with ground Sichuan peppercorns and scallions.

title: Slow Cooked Vegetable Japchae
summary: Sweet and savory stir-fried glass noodles with vegetables.
instructions:
1. Boil the sweet potato noodles until translucent and chewy, then drain and toss with sesame oil.
2. Individually sauté carrots, mushrooms, and onions.
3. Blanch and season the spinach.
4. Stir-fry marinated beef.
5. Combine noodles, vegetables, beef, and a sauce of soy sauce, sugar, and sesame oil. Mix well.

title: Zesty Pork Char Siu (Cantonese BBQ Pork)
summary: Sweet and savory roasted pork shoulder with a sticky glaze.

title: Restaurant-Style Shrimp Japchae
summary: Sweet and savory stir-fried glass noodles with vegetables.
instructions:

title: Chef's Special Duck Tteokbokki
summary: Chewy rice cakes cooked in a spicy, sweet gochujang sauce.
instructions:
1. Make a broth using dried kelp and anchovies.
2. Stir gochujang, sugar, and soy sauce into the broth.
3. Add the rice cakes and fish cakes to the spicy broth.
4. Simmer until the sauce thickens and the rice cakes are soft and chewy.
5. Top with scallions and halved hard-boiled eggs.

title: Authentic Duck Kung Pao Chicken
summary: Spicy, stir-fried Chinese dish made with cubes of chicken, peanuts, vegetables, and chili peppers.
instructions:
1. Marinate chicken in soy sauce and cornstarch.
2. Stir-fry chicken until browned, then remove from wok.
3. Fry dried chilies and Sichuan peppercorns until fragrant.
4. Add garlic, ginger, and scallions. Return chicken to wok.
5. Stir in peanuts and the sauce mixture. Cook until thickened.

title: Extra Spicy Beef Mapo Tofu
summary: Sichuan classic featuring silken tofu in a spicy, numbing sauce with minced pork.
instructions:
1. Simmer tofu blocks in lightly salted water for a minute, then drain.
2. Stir fry minced pork until crispy.
3. Add doubanjiang, garlic, and ginger, frying until the oil turns red.
4. Add broth and slide in the tofu. Simmer gently.
5. Thicken with cornstarch slurry and sprinkle with ground Sichuan peppercorns and scallions.

summary: Sweet pounded rice cakes, often filled with red bean paste.

title: Extra Spicy Pork Bibimbap
summary: Mixed rice bowl topped with vegetables, beef, a fried egg, and gochujang.
instructions:
1. Cook the rice and prepare individual vegetable sides (blanch and season).

title: Homestyle Tofu Tonkotsu Ramen
summary: Rich and creamy pork bone broth with fresh noodles.
instructions:

title: Premium Duck Kimchi Jjigae
summary: A warm, hearty, and spicy stew made with aged kimchi and pork.
instructions:
1. Sauté sliced pork belly in a pot until fat renders.
2. Add chopped aged kimchi and sauté for a few minutes.
3. Add water or anchovy broth and gochugaru, bring to a boil.
4. Simmer for 15-20 minutes, then add cubed tofu and scallions.
5. Serve bubbling hot with a side of rice.

title: Umami Beef Tteokbokki
summary: Chewy rice cakes cooked in a spicy, sweet gochujang sauce.
instructions:

title: Homestyle Shrimp Dim Sum Har Gow
summary: Translucent dumplings filled with plump shrimp.
instructions:
1. Finely mince half the shrimp and roughly chop the rest.
2. Mix shrimp with bamboo shoots, sesame oil, white pepper, and a pinch of sugar.
3. Prepare a dough using wheat and tapioca starch with boiling water.

title: Restaurant-Style Pork Chicken Teriyaki
summary: Grilled chicken glazed in a sweet soy sauce.
instructions:
1. Mix soy sauce, mirin, sake, and sugar. Simmer to slightly thicken.

title: Spicy Vegetable Mapo Tofu
summary: Sichuan classic featuring silken tofu in a spicy, numbing sauce with minced pork.
instructions:

summary: Savory Japanese cabbage pancake.

summary: Grilled chicken glazed in a sweet soy sauce.

instructions:
1. Cook the rice and prepare individual vegetable sides (blanch and season).
2. Marinate and stir-fry the thinly sliced beef.
3. Fry an egg sunny-side up.
4. Assemble the bowl: rice at the bottom, vegetables and meat arranged neatly on top.
5. Add a dollop of gochujang, top with the egg, and mix thoroughly before eating.

title: Street Style Shrimp Kung Pao Chicken
summary: Spicy, stir-fried Chinese dish made with cubes of chicken, peanuts, vegetables, and chili peppers.
instructions:
1. Marinate chicken in soy sauce and cornstarch.
2. Stir-fry chicken until browned, then remove from wok.
3. Fry dried chilies and Sichuan peppercorns until fragrant.
4. Add garlic, ginger, and scallions. Return chicken to wok.
5. Stir in peanuts and the sauce mixture. Cook until thickened.

title: Family Recipe Vegetable Tteokbokki
summary: Chewy rice cakes cooked in a spicy, sweet gochujang sauce.
instructions:
1. Make a broth using dried kelp and anchovies.
2. Stir gochujang, sugar, and soy sauce into the broth.
3. Add the rice cakes and fish cakes to the spicy broth.
4. Simmer until the sauce thickens and the rice cakes are soft and chewy.
5. Top with scallions and halved hard-boiled eggs.

title: Ginger Chicken Okonomiyaki
summary: Savory Japanese cabbage pancake.
instructions:
1. Shred the cabbage and mix with flour, eggs, and dashi to form a batter.
2. Pour the batter onto a hot teppan (griddle) and form a circle.
3. Lay thin slices of pork belly on top.
4. Flip and cook until both sides are golden and crispy.
5. Drizzle generously with okonomiyaki sauce, mayonnaise, and sprinkle with bonito flakes.

title: Spicy Vegetable Bibimbap

title: Ginger Beef Kimchi Jjigae
summary: A warm, hearty, and spicy stew made with aged kimchi and pork.
instructions:
1. Sauté sliced pork belly in a pot until fat renders.
2. Add chopped aged kimchi and sauté for a few minutes.
3. Add water or anchovy broth and gochugaru, bring to a boil.
4. Simmer for 15-20 minutes, then add cubed tofu and scallions.
5. Serve bubbling hot with a side of rice.

title: Sweet & Sour Mushroom Mochi
summary: Sweet pounded rice cakes, often filled with red bean paste.
instructions:
1. Mix glutinous rice flour, sugar, and water. Microwave or steam until dough becomes sticky and slightly translucent.
2. Dust a surface with cornstarch and turn out the hot dough.
3. Roll into small circles while still warm.
4. Place a ball of red bean paste in the center and pinch the dough closed around it.
5. Dust off excess cornstarch and serve.

summary: Savory Japanese cabbage pancake.

title: Restaurant-Style Mushroom Beef Chow Fun
summary: Stir-fried flat rice noodles with tender beef and bean sprouts.
instructions:
1. Marinate sliced beef in soy sauce, baking soda, and cornstarch.
2. Blanch the fresh rice noodles to soften them.
3. Stir-fry beef in a very hot wok until just browned, remove.
4. Stir-fry bean sprouts and scallions, then add noodles and soy sauces.
5. Toss everything together rapidly over high heat (wok hei).

title: Family Recipe Chicken Mapo Tofu
summary: Sichuan classic featuring silken tofu in a spicy, numbing sauce with minced pork.
instructions:
1. Simmer tofu blocks in lightly salted water for a minute, then drain.
2. Stir fry minced pork until crispy.
3. Add doubanjiang, garlic, and ginger, frying until the oil turns red.
4. Add broth and slide in the tofu. Simmer gently.
5. Thicken with cornstarch slurry and sprinkle with ground Sichuan peppercorns and scallions.

title: Spicy Mushroom Tteokbokki
summary: Chewy rice cakes cooked in a spicy, sweet gochujang sauce.
instructions:

title: Slow Cooked Beef Japchae
summary: Sweet and savory stir-fried glass noodles with vegetables.
instructions:
1. Boil the sweet potato noodles until translucent and chewy, then drain and toss with sesame oil.
2. Individually sauté carrots, mushrooms, and onions.
3. Blanch and season the spinach.
4. Stir-fry marinated beef.
5. Combine noodles, vegetables, beef, and a sauce of soy sauce, sugar, and sesame oil. Mix well.

title: Restaurant-Style Beef Tonkotsu Ramen
summary: Rich and creamy pork bone broth with fresh noodles.
instructions:
1. Boil pork bones at a rolling boil for 12-18 hours to extract collagen for a creamy broth.
2. Prepare tare (seasoning base) with soy sauce and mirin.
3. Boil noodles until chewy (al dente).
4. Place tare in a bowl, add the hot broth, and fold in the noodles.
5. Top with sliced chashu, a halved marinated egg, scallions, and nori.

title: Zesty Chicken Char Siu (Cantonese BBQ Pork)
summary: Sweet and savory roasted pork shoulder with a sticky glaze.
instructions:
1. Cut pork shoulder into thick strips.
2. Marinate the pork in a mixture of hoisin, soy sauce, honey, five-spice, and wine for 24 hours.
3. Roast in a hot oven, basting frequently with the marinade.
4. Broil for the last few minutes to char the edges.
5. Slice thinly and serve with rice.

title: Family-Style Pork Carbonara
summary: Rich pasta dish made with egg, hard cheese, cured pork, and black pepper.
instructions:
1. Boil pasta in salted water until al dente.
2. Crisp up the guanciale in a pan. Remove from heat.
3. Whisk eggs and grated Pecorino Romano in a bowl with lots of black pepper.
4. Quickly toss the hot pasta with the guanciale and its fat, then stir in the egg mixture.
5. Toss rapidly to create a creamy sauce, adding pasta water as needed. Do not scramble the eggs.

title: Family-Style Chicken Coq au Vin
summary: Classic French chicken braise with wine, lardons, and mushrooms.
instructions:
1. Fry lardons until crisp, then remove from the pot.
2. Brown chicken pieces in the bacon fat and remove.
3. Sauté pearl onions and mushrooms.
4. Return chicken and bacon to the pot, add garlic, thyme, and cover with red wine.
5. Braise in the oven for 1.5 hours until chicken is tender.

title: Premium Pork Wiener Schnitzel
summary: Thin, breaded, and pan-fried veal cutlet.
instructions:
1. Pound veal cutlets until very thin.
2. Set up a breading station: flour, beaten eggs, and breadcrumbs.
3. Dredge veal in flour, dip in egg, and coat with breadcrumbs.
4. Pan-fry in generous amounts of butter or clarified butter until golden and crispy.

title: Herb-Crusted Mushroom Pierogi

title: Chef's Beef Wiener Schnitzel
summary: Thin, breaded, and pan-fried veal cutlet.
instructions:

summary: Classic Neapolitan pizza with tomato sauce, fresh mozzarella, and basil.
instructions:

summary: Creamy saffron-infused rice dish.
instructions:

instructions:

1. Boil pasta in salted water until al dente.
2. Crisp up the guanciale in a pan. Remove from heat.

title: Slow-Cooked Veal Osso Buco
summary: Braised veal shanks cooked slowly with white wine, broth, and vegetables.
instructions:
1. Dust veal shanks with flour and brown them in hot oil.

title: Savory Beef Margherita Pizza
summary: Classic Neapolitan pizza with tomato sauce, fresh mozzarella, and basil.
instructions:
1. Stretch pizza dough into a thin circle.

title: Rustic Mushroom Bouillabaisse
summary: Traditional Provençal fish stew originating from Marseille.
instructions:
1. Sauté chopped leeks, fennel, and garlic in olive oil.

4. Add soft fish and shellfish, cooking until shells open.
5. Serve hot with rouille (garlic saffron mayonnaise) spread on toasted baguette.

title: Traditional Seafood Wiener Schnitzel
summary: Thin, breaded, and pan-fried veal cutlet.
instructions:

title: Slow-Cooked Veal Pierogi
summary: Polish dumplings filled with potatoes and cheese.
instructions:

title: Slow-Cooked Chicken Carbonara
summary: Rich pasta dish made with egg, hard cheese, cured pork, and black pepper.
instructions:
1. Boil pasta in salted water until al dente.
2. Crisp up the guanciale in a pan. Remove from heat.

title: Sunday Beef Risotto alla Milanese
summary: Creamy saffron-infused rice dish.
instructions:

instructions:

instructions:

instructions:
1. Make a pastry dough with flour, butter, and water. Chill.
2. Cook ground beef with onions, cumin, and paprika.
3. Roll out dough and cut circles.
4. Place beef filling, a slice of egg, and an olive on the dough. Fold and crimp edges.
5. Bake until golden or deep fry.

title: Zesty Vegetable Empanadas
summary: Baked or fried pastries filled with meat, cheese, or vegetables.
instructions:
1. Make a pastry dough with flour, butter, and water. Chill.
2. Cook ground beef with onions, cumin, and paprika.
3. Roll out dough and cut circles.
4. Place beef filling, a slice of egg, and an olive on the dough. Fold and crimp edges.
5. Bake until golden or deep fry.

title: Traditional Chicken Clam Chowder
summary: Thick and creamy soup containing clams and potatoes.
instructions:
1. Crisp the bacon in a pot, then remove. Sauté onions and celery in bacon fat.
2. Add diced potatoes and clam juice, simmer until potatoes are tender.
3. Stir in heavy cream and chopped clams.
4. Cook just until clams are heated through (do not boil).
5. Garnish with the crispy bacon and serve with oyster crackers.

title: Zesty Chicken Ceviche
summary: Fresh raw fish cured in citrus juices and spiced with ají or chili peppers.
instructions:
1. Dice the fish into small, even cubes.
2. Finely slice the red onion and chop cilantro.
3. Mix fish with salt, rocoto pepper, and freshly squeezed lime juice.
4. Let sit for 5-10 minutes until the outside of the fish turns opaque.
5. Serve immediately with sliced sweet potato and large kernel corn (choclo).

title: Zesty Beef Empanadas
summary: Baked or fried pastries filled with meat, cheese, or vegetables.

5. Bake until golden or deep fry.

title: Garlic Chicken Arepas
summary: Cornmeal cakes that can be grilled, baked, or fried, split open and stuffed.
instructions:
1. Mix masarepa with water and salt to form a soft dough.
2. Form the dough into thick discs.
3. Grill or pan-fry the arepas until a crust forms on both sides.
4. Split them open like a pocket.
5. Stuff with shredded beef, black beans, and grated cheese.

title: Zesty Shrimp Arepas

title: Cajun Shrimp Shepherd's Pie
summary: Meat pie with a crust or topping of mashed potato.
instructions:
1. Boil and mash the potatoes with butter and milk.
2. Sauté onions, carrots, and ground lamb until browned.
3. Stir in flour, then beef broth, and simmer until gravy thickens. Add peas.
4. Pour the meat mixture into a baking dish.
5. Top with mashed potatoes and bake until the top is golden and filling is bubbly.

title: Premium Shrimp Mole Poblano
summary: Traditional Mexican dish with a complex, rich, and slightly sweet chili-chocolate sauce.
instructions:
1. Toast chiles and soak in warm water.
2. Fry almonds, sesame seeds, and plantains.
3. Blend chiles, nuts, spices, and chocolate into a smooth paste.
4. Cook the paste in a little oil, then add chicken broth and simmer until thick.
5. Serve over boiled chicken pieces with rice and tortillas.

title: Garlic Shrimp Fish & Chips
summary: Crispy battered fried fish served with thick-cut chips.
instructions:
1. Cut potatoes into thick chips and fry them twice (once at lower temp, once at high temp) for crispiness.
2. Mix flour, baking powder, salt, and cold beer for the batter.
3. Dip fish fillets into the batter and immediately drop into hot oil.
4. Fry until golden brown and crispy.
5. Serve with chips, tartar sauce, and a splash of malt vinegar.

title: Smoky Chicken Shepherd's Pie
summary: Meat pie with a crust or topping of mashed potato.
instructions:
1. Boil and mash the potatoes with butter and milk.
2. Sauté onions, carrots, and ground lamb until browned.
3. Stir in flour, then beef broth, and simmer until gravy thickens. Add peas.
4. Pour the meat mixture into a baking dish.
5. Top with mashed potatoes and bake until the top is golden and filling is bubbly.

title: Hearty Pork Clam Chowder
summary: Thick and creamy soup containing clams and potatoes.
instructions:
1. Crisp the bacon in a pot, then remove. Sauté onions and celery in bacon fat.
2. Add diced potatoes and clam juice, simmer until potatoes are tender.
3. Stir in heavy cream and chopped clams.
4. Cook just until clams are heated through (do not boil).
5. Garnish with the crispy bacon and serve with oyster crackers.

title: Cajun Beef Ceviche
summary: Fresh raw fish cured in citrus juices and spiced with ají or chili peppers.
instructions:
1. Dice the fish into small, even cubes.
2. Finely slice the red onion and chop cilantro.
3. Mix fish with salt, rocoto pepper, and freshly squeezed lime juice.
4. Let sit for 5-10 minutes until the outside of the fish turns opaque.
5. Serve immediately with sliced sweet potato and large kernel corn (choclo).

title: Falafel Wrap
summary: Crispy chickpea fritters in a warm pita.
instructions:
1. Soak chickpeas overnight.
2. Blend chickpeas with herbs and spices.
3. Form into balls and deep fry until crispy.
4. Warm the pita bread.
5. Stuff with falafel, fresh veggies, and drizzle with tahini sauce.

title: Shakshuka
summary: Eggs poached in a sauce of tomatoes, chili peppers, and onions.
instructions:
1. Sauté onions, peppers, and garlic.
2. Add tomatoes and spices, simmer until thick.
3. Make small wells in the sauce.
4. Crack an egg into each well.
5. Cover and cook until eggs are set. Serve with crusty bread.

title: Moussaka
summary: Layered eggplant and spiced meat casserole.
instructions:
1. Slice and roast eggplant.
2. Cook ground meat with onions, garlic, and tomatoes.
3. Prepare béchamel sauce.
4. Layer eggplant and meat mixture in a baking dish.
5. Top with béchamel and bake until golden brown.

title: Baklava
summary: Rich, sweet dessert pastry made of layers of filo filled with chopped nuts.
instructions:
1. Mix chopped nuts with cinnamon.
2. Layer filo sheets, brushing each with melted butter.
3. Spread nut mixture evenly.
4. Add more buttered filo layers on top.
5. Bake until golden, then pour cold honey syrup over hot pastry.

title: Chicken Shawarma
summary: Thinly sliced marinated chicken roasted on a slow-turning vertical spit.
instructions:
1. Marinate chicken in yogurt and spices overnight.
2. Roast or grill the chicken until tender and slightly charred.
3. Slice the chicken thinly.
4. Serve in pita bread with garlic sauce and pickles.

title: Jollof Rice
summary: A vibrant red, one-pot rice dish with a base of tomatoes, onions, and peppers.
instructions:
1. Blend tomatoes, peppers, and onions into a smooth purée.
2. Fry the purée in oil until reduced and oil floats.
3. Add chicken broth, thyme, and bay leaves.
4. Stir in the washed rice, cover tightly.
5. Cook on very low heat until rice is tender and has a slightly smoky flavor at the bottom.

title: Injera with Doro Wat
summary: Spicy chicken stew served on a spongy, fermented flatbread.
instructions:
1. Prepare injera batter and let it ferment for 2-3 days, then cook into flatbreads.
2. Sauté finely diced onions slowly until caramelized.
3. Add Berbere spice and niter kibbeh.
4. Add chicken pieces and simmer until tender.
5. Add hard-boiled eggs and serve the stew over injera.

title: Jerk Chicken
summary: Spicy, smoky grilled chicken marinated in a fiery Jamaican spice blend.
instructions:
1. Blend all marinade ingredients to form a paste.
2. Rub the paste generously over the chicken and marinate overnight.
3. Prepare a grill, ideally with pimento wood.
4. Grill the chicken slowly over medium heat.
5. Serve hot with rice and peas.

title: Hummus with Warm Pita
summary: Creamy dip made from mashed chickpeas, blended with tahini, lemon juice, and garlic.
instructions:
1. Boil chickpeas until very tender.
2. Blend chickpeas with tahini, lemon juice, and garlic until smooth.
3. Slowly drizzle in olive oil while blending.
4. Serve in a shallow bowl, drizzled with more olive oil.
5. Accompany with warm pita bread.

title: Tagine of Lamb with Apricots
summary: A slow-cooked savory stew named after the earthenware pot in which it is cooked.
instructions:
1. Brown the lamb in a tagine or heavy pot.
2. Add spices, onions, and water, then simmer slowly.
3. Toast almonds in a separate pan.
4. Add dried apricots and a touch of honey to the stew.
5. Simmer until lamb is tender. Serve with couscous.

4. Grill the chicken slowly over medium heat.
5. Serve hot with rice and peas.

title: Delicious Delicious Delicious Delicious Hearty Baklava
summary: Rich, sweet dessert pastry made of layers of filo filled with chopped nuts.
instructions:
1. Mix chopped nuts with cinnamon.
2. Layer filo sheets, brushing each with melted butter.
3. Spread nut mixture evenly.
4. Add more buttered filo layers on top.
5. Bake until golden, then pour cold honey syrup over hot pastry.

title: Pad Thai
summary: A classic Thai stir-fried rice noodle dish.
instructions:
1. Soak rice noodles until pliable.
2. Stir-fry tofu, eggs, and shrimp (if using) in a wok.
3. Add noodles and toss with tamarind and fish sauce.
4. Stir in bean sprouts and peanuts.
5. Serve with lime wedges and chili flakes.

title: Tom Yum Goong
summary: Hot and sour Thai soup with shrimp.
instructions:
1. Boil broth with lemongrass, galangal, and kaffir lime leaves.
2. Add mushrooms and boil briefly.
3. Add shrimp and cook until pink.
4. Season with fish sauce, lime juice, and chili paste.
5. Garnish with fresh cilantro.

title: Pho
summary: Vietnamese noodle soup consisting of broth, rice noodles, herbs, and meat.
instructions:
1. Simmer beef bones with charred onions and ginger for hours.
2. Toast star anise and cinnamon, add to broth.
3. Place soaked rice noodles in a bowl.
4. Top with raw thinly sliced beef.
5. Pour boiling broth over the beef to cook it. Garnish with herbs.

title: Banh Mi
summary: Vietnamese sandwich featuring a fusion of meats and vegetables in a French baguette.
instructions:
1. Slice the baguette and toast lightly.
2. Spread pate and mayo on the bread.
3. Layer with sliced pork or cold cuts.
4. Top generously with pickled carrots, daikon, cilantro, and jalapenos.
5. Serve immediately.

title: Nasi Goreng
summary: Indonesian stir-fried rice with a sweet soy sauce and a fried egg on top.
instructions:
1. Heat oil and fry shallots, garlic, and chili.
2. Add prawns and stir-fry until cooked.
3. Add cold day-old rice and toss well.
4. Stir in Kecap Manis and cook until caramelized.
5. Serve topped with a sunny-side-up fried egg.

title: Beef Rendang
summary: Rich, tender Indonesian coconut beef stew.
instructions:
1. Blend spices into a paste.
2. Sauté the spice paste until fragrant.
3. Add beef chunks and coconut milk.
4. Simmer uncovered for several hours.
5. Cook until the liquid has evaporated and the meat is caramelized.

title: Laksa
summary: Spicy noodle soup popular in Maritime Southeast Asia.
instructions:
1. Fry the laksa paste until fragrant.
2. Add coconut milk and broth, bring to a simmer.
3. Add shrimp and tofu puffs, cook briefly.
4. Blanch noodles and bean sprouts, place in a bowl.
5. Ladle the hot soup over the noodles.

title: Schnitzel
summary: Thin slice of meat, breaded and fried, a classic German/Austrian dish.
instructions:
1. Pound the meat until very thin.
2. Dredge in flour, dip in beaten eggs, then coat in breadcrumbs.
3. Melt butter and oil in a large skillet.
4. Fry the schnitzel until golden brown and crispy on both sides.
5. Serve with a slice of lemon.

title: Pierogi
summary: Filled dumplings of Central European origin.
instructions:
1. Make a simple dough of flour and water.

3. Roll out dough and cut into circles.

5. Boil until they float, then pan-fry in butter with onions.

instructions:
1. Blend spices into a paste.
2. Sauté the spice paste until fragrant.
3. Add beef chunks and coconut milk.
4. Simmer uncovered for several hours.
5. Cook until the liquid has evaporated and the meat is caramelized.

title: Delicious Delicious Fresh Nasi Goreng
summary: Indonesian stir-fried rice with a sweet soy sauce and a fried egg on top.
instructions:
1. Heat oil and fry shallots, garlic, and chili.
2. Add prawns and stir-fry until cooked.
3. Add cold day-old rice and toss well.
4. Stir in Kecap Manis and cook until caramelized.
5. Serve topped with a sunny-side-up fried egg.

title: Delicious Delicious Delicious Aromatic Pad Thai
summary: A classic Thai stir-fried rice noodle dish.
instructions:
1. Soak rice noodles until pliable.
2. Stir-fry tofu, eggs, and shrimp (if using) in a wok.
3. Add noodles and toss with tamarind and fish sauce.
4. Stir in bean sprouts and peanuts.
5. Serve with lime wedges and chili flakes.

title: Delicious Spicy Laksa
summary: Spicy noodle soup popular in Maritime Southeast Asia.
instructions:
1. Fry the laksa paste until fragrant.
2. Add coconut milk and broth, bring to a simmer.
3. Add shrimp and tofu puffs, cook briefly.
4. Blanch noodles and bean sprouts, place in a bowl.
5. Ladle the hot soup over the noodles.

title: Delicious Aromatic Schnitzel
summary: Thin slice of meat, breaded and fried, a classic German/Austrian dish.
instructions:
1. Pound the meat until very thin.
2. Dredge in flour, dip in beaten eggs, then coat in breadcrumbs.
3. Melt butter and oil in a large skillet.
4. Fry the schnitzel until golden brown and crispy on both sides.
5. Serve with a slice of lemon.

title: Delicious Delicious Delicious Delicious Classic Tom Yum Goong
summary: Hot and sour Thai soup with shrimp.
instructions:
1. Boil broth with lemongrass, galangal, and kaffir lime leaves.
2. Add mushrooms and boil briefly.
3. Add shrimp and cook until pink.
4. Season with fish sauce, lime juice, and chili paste.
5. Garnish with fresh cilantro.

title: Delicious Delicious Delicious Aromatic Pierogi
summary: Filled dumplings of Central European origin.
instructions:
1. Make a simple dough of flour and water.
2. Prepare filling with mashed potatoes and cheese.
3. Roll out dough and cut into circles.
4. Place filling, fold into half-moons, and seal.
5. Boil until they float, then pan-fry in butter with onions.
